section-73-3.TO: delegate any of its functions as a licensing authority to such persons as it considers appropriate

take such steps as are necessary to ensure an appropriate financial and organisational separation between the activities of the Board that relate to the carrying out of its functions as a licensing authority and the other activities of the Board

section-76-1.TO: by order cancel an approved regulator's designation as a licensing authority
section-76-1.IN RELATION TO: all the reserved legal activities in relation to which it is designated

section-76-1.TO: by order cancel an approved regulator's designation as a licensing authority
section-76-1.IN RELATION TO: one or more, but not all, of those reserved legal activities, with effect from a date specified in the order

section-76-2.ONLY IN ACCORDANCE WITH: a recommendation made by the Board under subsection (3) or (5)

section-76-3.TO: recommend that an order is made cancelling an approved regulator's designation as a licensing authority in relation to one or more reserved legal activities
section-76-3.IF: — (a) the approved regulator applies to the Board for such a recommendation to be made, (b) the application is made in such form and manner as may be prescribed by rules made by the Board, and is accompanied by the prescribed fee, and (c) the approved regulator publishes a notice giving details of the application in accordance with such requirements as may be specified in rules made by the Board

section-76-5.TO: recommend that an order is made cancelling an approved regulator's designation as a licensing authority in relation to one or more reserved legal activities
section-76-5.IF: it is satisfied— (a) that an act or omission of the licensing authority (or a series of such acts or omissions) has had, or is likely to have, an adverse impact on one or more of the regulatory objectives, and (b) that it is appropriate to cancel the approved regulator's designation in relation to the activity or activities in question in all the circumstances of the case (including in particular the impact of cancelling the designation on the other regulatory objectives)

section-76-6.TO: determine that it is appropriate to cancel an approved regulator's designation as a licensing authority
section-76-6.UNLESS: it is satisfied that the matter cannot be adequately addressed by the Board exercising the powers available to it under sections 31 to 43

section-76-8.TO: give the Board notice of the decision and the reasons for it
section-76-8.IF: the Lord Chancellor decides not to make an order in response to a recommendation made under subsection (3) or (5)

section-76-9.TO: publish a notice given under subsection (8)

section-77-2.TO: by order make— (a) such modifications of provisions made by or under any enactment (including this Act or any enactment passed after this Act), prerogative instrument or other instrument or document, and (b) such transitional or consequential provision, as the Lord Chancellor considers necessary or expedient in consequence of the cancellation

section-77-6.TO: make such provision as is necessary to ensure that, where a licensed body is treated under those arrangements as being authorised to carry on a protected activity by the new authority, that licensed body is subject to the licensing rules of the new authority

make provision requiring amounts held by the former authority which represent amounts paid to it by way of licensing fees by the consenting licensed bodies (or a part of the amounts so held) to be paid to the new authority and treated as if they were amounts paid by those licensed bodies by way of licensing fees to the new authority

section-77-8.TO: make an order under this section
section-77-8.ONLY IF: — (a) the Board has made a recommendation in accordance with section 78, and (b) the order is in the same form as, or in a form which is not materially different from, the draft order annexed to that recommendation

section-78-1.TO: recommend to the Lord Chancellor that the Lord Chancellor make an order under section 77 in the form of a draft order prepared by the Board and annexed to the recommendation

section-78-2.TO: publish a draft of— (a) the proposed recommendation, and (b) the proposed draft order
section-78-2.BEFORE: making a recommendation under this section

section-78-3.TO: be accompanied by a notice which states that representations about the proposals may be made to the Board within a specified period

section-78-4.TO: have regard to any representations duly made

section-78-5.TO: publish the draft order along with a statement detailing the changes made and the reasons for those changes
section-78-5.IF: the draft order to be annexed to the recommendation differs from the draft published under subsection (2)(b) in a way which is, in the opinion of the Board, material

section-79-2.TO: request the former authority to provide assistance to the new authority and the Board for the purpose of continuing regulation

section-79-3.FOR: a judge of the High Court, Circuit judge or justice of the peace
section-79-3.TO: issue a warrant authorising a person appointed by the Board to act on its behalf to— (a) enter and search the premises of the former authority, and (b) take possession of any written or electronic records found on the premises

section-79-4.TO: for the purpose of continuing regulation, take copies of written or electronic records found on a search carried out by virtue of the warrant

section-79-5.FOR: The judge or justice of the peace
section-79-5.UNLESS: satisfied that its issue is necessary or desirable for the purpose of continuing regulation

section-79-6.TO: make regulations— (a) specifying further matters which a judge or justice of the peace must be satisfied of, or matters which a judge or justice of the peace must have regard to, before issuing a warrant, and (b) regulating the exercise of a power conferred by a warrant issued under subsection (3) or by subsection (4) (whether by restricting the circumstances in which a power may be exercised, by specifying conditions to be complied with in the exercise of a power, or otherwise)

section-79-7.TO: make provision as to circumstances in which written or electronic records of which a person has taken possession by virtue of a warrant issued under subsection (3) may be copied or must be returned

section-79-8.UNLESS: — (a) they are made in accordance with a recommendation made by the Board, or (b) the Lord Chancellor has consulted the Board about the making of the regulations

section-79-9.TO: make rules as to the persons it may appoint for the purposes of subsection (3)

section-80-1.TO: by order— (a) establish a body to hear and determine appeals from decisions, made by a person specified in the order in the person's capacity as a licensing authority, which are appealable under this Part or licensing rules made by the person; (b) modify, or make any other provision relating to, the functions of a body within subsection (2) or any other body, for the purpose of enabling the body to hear and determine appeals from such decisions

section-80-3.ONLY IF: — (a) the Board has made a recommendation in accordance with section 81, (b) a draft order was annexed to the recommendation, and (c) the order is in the same form as, or not materially different from, that draft order

section-80-4.TO: — (a) make provision as to the payment of fees, and award of costs, in relation to such appeals; (b) modify provisions made by or under any enactment (including this Act or any Act passed after this Act), prerogative instrument or other instrument or document

section-80-5.FOR: Any provision made by an order under this section
section-80-5.TO: be expressed to be conditional upon the person specified in the order being designated by an order under Part 1 of Schedule 10 as a licensing authority in relation to one or more reserved legal activities

section-81-1.ONLY WITH: the consent of— (a) the person from whose decisions the appeals are to be made, and (b) where the recommendation is for an order under section 80(1)(b), the body to which appeals are to be made

section-81-2.TO: publish a draft of— (a) the proposed recommendation, and (b) the proposed draft order
section-81-2.BEFORE: making a recommendation under that section

section-81-3.TO: be accompanied by a notice which states that representations about the proposals may be made to the Board within a specified period

section-81-4.TO: have regard to any representations duly made

section-81-5.TO: publish the draft order along with a statement detailing the changes made and the reasons for those changes
section-81-5.IF: the draft order to be annexed to the recommendation differs from the draft published under subsection (2)(b) in a way which is, in the opinion of the Board, material

section-82-1.TO: prepare and issue a statement of policy as to how, in exercising its functions under this Part, it will comply with the requirements of section 28 (or, in the case of the Board, section 3) (duties to promote regulatory objectives etc)

section-82-2.ONLY WITH: the approval of the Board (acting otherwise than in its capacity as a licensing authority or as an approved regulator)

section-82-3.TO: alter or replace a statement issued under this section
section-82-3.WITH: the approval of the Board (acting otherwise than in its capacity as a licensing authority or as an approved regulator)

section-82-4.TO: issue the altered or replacement statement

section-82-5.TO: have regard to the statement issued by it under this section
section-82-5.IN: exercising its functions under this Part

section-82-6.TO: publish a statement issued by it under this section

section-83-1.FOR: The Board (acting in its capacity as a licensing authority)
section-83-1.BEFORE: the end of the period of 12 months beginning with the day on which a licensable body first becomes entitled to make an application to it for a licence by virtue of a decision of the Board (acting otherwise than in its capacity as a licensing authority or as an approved regulator) under Schedule 12

section-83-1.FOR: The Board (acting in its capacity as a licensing authority)
section-83-1.TO: make or modify its licensing rules
section-83-1.ONLY WITH: the approval of the Board (acting otherwise than in its capacity as a licensing authority or as an approved regulator)

section-83-5.FOR: Licensing rules of a licensing authority
section-83-5.TO: contain— (a) appropriate qualification regulations in respect of licensable bodies to which the licensing authority proposes to issue licences under this Part, (b) provision as to how the licensing authority, when considering the regulatory objectives (in compliance with its duties under section 3(2) or 28(2)) in connection with an application for a licence, should take account of the objective of improving access to justice, (c) appropriate arrangements (including conduct rules, discipline rules and practice rules) under which the licensing authority will be able to regulate the conduct of bodies licensed by it, and their managers and employees, (d) appropriate indemnification arrangements, (e) appropriate compensation arrangements, (f) the provision required by sections 52 and 54 (resolution of regulatory conflict) (including those provisions as applied by section 103), (g) the provision required by sections 112 and 145 (requirements imposed in relation to the handling of complaints), and (h) any other provision required to be contained in licensing rules by this Act
section-83-5.SUBJECT TO: — (a) section 105 (which exempts trade unions from certain provisions), and (b) section 106 (which provides for the modification of licensing rules in their application to bodies to which that section applies)

section-83-6.FOR: licensing rules of a licensing authority
section-83-6.TO: Without prejudice to the generality of subsection (4), contain any provision authorised by this Act
section-83-6.SUBJECT TO: — (a) section 105 (which exempts trade unions from certain provisions), and (b) section 106 (which provides for the modification of licensing rules in their application to bodies to which that section applies)

section-83-9.TO: apply to bodies to which section 106 applies in a way which is different from the way they apply to other bodies
section-83-9.EXCEPT: by virtue of an order under that section

section-84-1.FOR: A licensing authority other than the Board
section-84-1.TO: determine any application for a licence which is made to it

section-84-2.FOR: The Board (acting in its capacity as a licensing authority)
section-84-2.TO: determine an application for a licence which is made to it
section-84-2.ONLY IF: the applicant is entitled to make the application by virtue of a decision of the Board (acting otherwise than in its capacity as a licensing authority) under Schedule 12

section-84-3.TO: grant an application for a licence
section-84-3.UNLESS: it is satisfied that if the licence is granted the applicant will comply with its licensing rules

section-84-4.IF: it grants an application for a licence

section-85-1.TO: specify— (a) the activities which are reserved legal activities and which the licensed body is authorised to carry on by virtue of the licence, and (b) any conditions subject to which the licence is granted

section-85-2.TO: specify the terms of the order
section-85-2.IF: an order under section 106 has been made in relation to the licensed body

section-85-3.TO: authorise the licensed body to carry on activities which are reserved legal activities
section-85-3.IN THE CASE OF: a licensing authority other than the Board
section-85-3.ONLY IF: the licensing authority is designated in relation to the reserved legal activities in question

section-85-4.SUBJECT TO: the condition that— (a) any obligation which may from time to time be imposed on the licensed body or a person within subsection (5) by or under the licensing authority's licensing rules is complied with, and (b) any other obligations imposed on the licensed body or a person within that subsection by or under this or any other enactment (whether passed before or after this Act) are complied with

section-85-6.SUBJECT TO: such other conditions as the licensing authority considers appropriate

section-85-7.TO: include conditions as to the non-reserved activities which the licensed body may or may not carry on

section-86-1.TO: modify the terms of a licence granted by it
section-86-1.IF: the licensed body applies to the licensing authority, in accordance with its licensing rules, for it to do so

section-86-1.TO: modify the terms of a licence granted by it
section-86-1.IN: such other circumstances as may be specified in its licensing rules

section-86-2.TO: modify the terms of its licence in accordance with sections 106 and 107
section-86-2.IF: a licensed body is a body to which section 106 applies

section-87-1.TO: keep a register containing the names and places of business of all bodies which hold or have held licences granted by the licensing authority

section-87-3.TO: provide facilities for making the information contained in the entries in its register available for inspection by any person during office hours and without payment

section-87-4.TO: make rules about— (a) the register to be kept by the Board under this section, and (b) the register to be kept under this section by each licensing authority designated under Part 1 of Schedule 10

section-87-5.TO: prescribe any further information which must be contained in an entry in the register in relation to a licensed body or former licensed body

section-91-1.FOR: The Head of Legal Practice of a licensed body
section-91-1.TO: — (a) take all reasonable steps to ensure compliance with the terms of the licensed body's licence, and (b) as soon as reasonably practicable, report to the licensing authority any failure to comply with the terms of the licence
section-91-1.UNLESS: this concerns the terms of the licence so far as they require compliance with licensing rules made under paragraph 20 of Schedule 11 (accounts) (as to which see section 92)

section-91-3.FOR: The Head of Legal Practice of a licensed body
section-91-3.TO: — (a) take all reasonable steps to ensure that the licensed body, and any of its employees or managers who are authorised persons in relation to an activity which is a reserved legal activity, comply with the duties imposed by section 176, and (b) as soon as reasonably practicable, report to the licensing authority such failures by those persons to comply with those duties as may be specified in licensing rules

section-91-4.FOR: The Head of Legal Practice of a licensed body
section-91-4.TO: take all reasonable steps to ensure that non-authorised persons subject to the duty imposed by section 90 in relation to the licensed body comply with that duty

section-91-4.FOR: The Head of Legal Practice of a licensed body
section-91-4.TO: report to the licensing authority any failure by a non-authorised person to comply with that duty

section-92-1.FOR: The Head of Finance and Administration of a licensed body
section-92-1.TO: take all reasonable steps to ensure compliance with licensing rules made under paragraph 20 of Schedule 11 (accounts)

section-92-2.FOR: The Head of Finance and Administration
section-92-2.TO: report any breach of those rules to the licensing authority

section-93-1.FOR: The relevant licensing authority in relation to a licensed body
section-93-1.TO: by notice require a person within subsection (2)— (a) to provide information, or information of a description, specified in the notice, or (b) produce documents, or documents of a description, specified in the notice, for the purpose of enabling the licensing authority to ascertain whether the terms of the licensed body's licence are being, or have been, complied with

section-93-3.TO: specify the manner and form in which any information is to be provided
specify the period within which the information is to be provided or the document produced
require the information to be provided, or the document to be produced, to the licensing authority or to a person specified in the notice

section-93-4.TO: by notice, require a person within subsection (2) (or a representative of such a person) to attend at a time and place specified in the notice to provide an explanation of any information provided or document produced under this section

section-93-5.TO: pay to any person such reasonable costs as may be incurred by that person in connection with— (a) the provision of any information, or production of any document, by that person pursuant to a notice under subsection (1), or (b) that person's compliance with a requirement imposed under subsection (4)

section-93-6.FOR: The licensing authority, or a person specified under subsection (3)(c) in a notice
section-93-6.TO: take copies of or extracts from a document produced pursuant to a notice under subsection (1)

section-94-1.TO: give the licensing authority a notice to that effect stating the reasons why the person cannot comply
section-94-1.WHERE: the person is unable to comply with a notice given to the person under section 93

section-94-2.TO: apply to the High Court for an order requiring a person to comply with a notice under section 93 or with such directions for the like purpose as may be contained in the order
section-94-2.IF: the person refuses or otherwise fails to comply with the notice

section-95-1.TO: impose on a licensed body, or a manager or employee of a licensed body, a penalty of such amount as it considers appropriate

section-95-2.TO: exceed the maximum amount prescribed under subsection (3)

section-95-3.TO: make rules prescribing the maximum amount of a penalty which may be imposed under this section

section-95-4.ONLY WITH: the consent of the Lord Chancellor

section-96-1.FOR: a person on whom a penalty is imposed under section 95
section-96-1.TO: appeal to the relevant appellate body on one or more of the appeal grounds
section-96-1.BEFORE: the end of such period as may be prescribed by rules made by the Board

section-96-3.TO: — (a) quash the penalty, (b) substitute a penalty of such lesser amount as it considers appropriate
section-96-3.WHERE: that body considers it appropriate to do so in all the circumstances of the case and is satisfied of one or more of the appeal grounds

section-96-3.TO: substitute for any time imposed by the licensing authority a different time or times
section-96-3.WHERE: that body considers it appropriate to do so in all the circumstances of the case and is satisfied of one or more of the appeal grounds

section-96-4.TO: require the payment of interest on the substituted penalty at such rate, and from such time, as it considers just and equitable
section-96-4.WHERE: it substitutes a penalty of a lesser amount

section-96-5.TO: require the payment of interest on the penalty, or portion, from that time at such rate as it considers just and equitable
section-96-5.WHERE: the relevant appellate body specifies as a time by which the penalty, or a portion of the penalty, is to be paid a time before the determination of the appeal under this section

section-96-6.TO: appeal to the High Court on a point of law arising from the decision of the relevant appellate body
section-96-6.ONLY WITH: the permission of the High Court

section-96-7.TO: make such order as it thinks fit

section-97-3.TO: pay into the Consolidated Fund any sum received by it as a penalty (or as interest on a penalty)

section-98-1.TO: refer to an appropriate regulator any matter relating to the conduct of— (a) an employee or manager of a licensed body; (b) a person designated as a licensed body's Head of Legal Practice or Head of Finance and Administration

section-98-2.TO: refer any matter relating to the conduct of such a person to the Board

section-99-1.TO: disqualify a person from one or more of the activities mentioned in subsection (2)
section-99-1.IF: — (a) the disqualification condition is satisfied in relation to the person, and (b) the licensing authority is satisfied that it is undesirable for the person to engage in that activity or those activities

section-100-1.TO: keep lists of persons who are disqualified from— (a) acting as Head of Legal Practice of any licensed body, (b) acting as Head of Finance and Administration of any licensed body, (c) being a manager of any licensed body, or (d) being employed by any licensed body

section-100-6.TO: publish the lists kept by it under subsection (1)

section-101-1.TO: suspend or revoke any licence granted by it under this Part

section-106-2.FOR: A body to which this section applies
section-106-2.TO: apply to the relevant licensing authority for the authority to make an order under this section

section-106-3.TO: make one or both of the following orders— (a) that the authority's licensing rules apply in relation to the body with such modifications as may be specified in the order; (b) that Schedule 13 does not apply in relation to the body, or applies in relation to the body with such modifications as may be specified in the order

section-106-4.TO: make any order which the authority— (a) has power to make under subsection (3), and (b) considers appropriate in all the circumstances of the case, whether or not it is the order for which the applicant applied

section-106-5.TO: have regard to— (a) the reserved legal activities and non-reserved activities which the body carries on (or proposes to carry on), (b) the nature of the persons to whom the body provides (or proposes to provide) services, (c) any non-authorised persons who have an interest or an indirect interest in the licensed body or hold a material interest in the licensed body, or are managers of the body, and (d) any other matter specified in the authority's licensing rules
section-106-5.IN: deciding what order (if any) is appropriate in all the circumstances of the case

section-106-7.TO: make an order under subsection (3)(a) in relation to provisions of its licensing rules made in accordance with the following paragraphs of Schedule 11— (a) paragraphs 2 and 3 (determination and review of applications for a licence); (b) paragraphs 7 and 8 (applications under this section); (c) paragraphs 9(3), 18 and 23 (disqualifications); (d) paragraph 10(2) (management); (e) paragraph 16 (carrying on of licensed activities); (f) paragraph 24(1), (2), (3) and (8) (grounds for suspending and revoking licences); (g) paragraph 24(10) and (11) (procedure for suspending or revoking licence); (h) paragraph 26(2) (review of decision to suspend or revoke licence)

section-106-8.TO: make an order under subsection (3)(a) which results in its licensing rules, as they apply in relation to the body to which the order relates, not making the provision required by— (a) section 83(5)(a) to (g); (b) paragraph 1 of Schedule 11 (applications for licences); (c) paragraph 4(3) of that Schedule (renewal of licences); (d) paragraph 6 of that Schedule (modification of licence); (e) paragraph 20 of that Schedule (accounts)

section-107-2.IF: it becomes aware that the body in respect of which the order was made is no longer a body to which that section applies

section-107-3.TO: revoke or otherwise modify an order under section 106
section-107-3.ON: the application of the body in relation to which the order was made

section-107-3.TO: revoke or otherwise modify an order under section 106 of its own motion

section-107-4.ONLY IF: it considers it appropriate to do so in all the circumstances of the case, having regard to the matters mentioned in section 106(5)

section-110-1.TO: deal with how, in the Board's opinion, the activities of licensing authorities and licensed bodies have affected the regulatory objectives
section-110-1.UNLESS: this concerns an annual report for a financial year before the first financial year in which a licence is issued under this Part
